    "about": {
      "title": "About OAM",
      "intro": "One app for the everyday things Nigerians pay for, sell, and hire — built to be quick, honest, and safe with your money.",
      "whatTitle": "What OAM is",
      "whatP1": "OAM is a multi-service platform operated by <1>O.A.M Motors Limited</1>. It brings together the things most people currently juggle across half a dozen apps: topping up airtime, buying electricity units, paying for TV, sending money, selling something you no longer need, and finding a tradesperson you can trust.",
      "whatP2": "Everything runs through a single wallet, so you can see exactly what you've spent and what you're owed — and every purchase produces a receipt you can find again.",
      "doTitle": "What you can do here",
      "svc": {
        "bills": {
          "title": "Bills and utilities",
          "body": "Airtime, data, electricity tokens and TV subscriptions, delivered in seconds and receipted by email."
        },
        "wallet": {
          "title": "Wallet and transfers",
          "body": "Fund by card, send to another OAM user instantly, or withdraw to your own bank account."
        },
        "marketplace": {
          "title": "Marketplace",
          "body": "Buy and sell within the OAM community, with messaging built in so your phone number stays private."
        },
        "services": {
          "title": "Home services",
          "body": "Find verified plumbers, electricians, mechanics and cleaners near you."
        },
        "travel": {
          "title": "Travel",
          "body": "Compare flights, hotels, car hire and airport pickups worldwide."
        },
        "airtimeData": {
          "title": "Airtime",
          "body": "Instantly top up any Nigerian network — MTN, Airtel, Glo and 9mobile."
        },
        "data": {
          "title": "Data",
          "body": "Buy data bundles for every major network, at the plan that suits you."
        },
        "electricity": {
          "title": "Electricity",
          "body": "Pay prepaid and postpaid meters across Nigeria and get your token instantly."
        },
        "cable": {
          "title": "Cable TV",
          "body": "Renew DStv, GOtv, StarTimes and other subscriptions without leaving home."
        },
        "transfers": {
          "title": "Transfers",
          "body": "Send money free to other OAM users, or withdraw to your own bank account."
        },
        "artisans": {
          "title": "Artisans",
          "body": "Find and hire verified local plumbers, electricians, mechanics, cleaners and more."
        },
        "flights": {
          "title": "Flights",
          "body": "Compare and book domestic and international flights from hundreds of airlines."
        },
        "hotels": {
          "title": "Hotels",
          "body": "Search and book hotel stays in over 100 countries with instant confirmation."
        },
        "carhire": {
          "title": "Car Hire",
          "body": "Rent cars with or without a driver at thousands of locations worldwide."
        },
        "ecommerce": {
          "title": "E-commerce",
          "body": "Shop top international stores like Amazon, Temu and Alibaba through OAM."
        },
        "betting": {
          "title": "Fund Betting",
          "body": "Top up your sports betting account instantly across top providers in Nigeria."
        },
        "busTickets": {
          "title": "Bus Tickets",
          "body": "Search and book intercity bus tickets for travel across Nigeria."
        }
      },
      "moneyTitle": "How we make money",
      "moneyP1": "We think you should know this, because a service that hides its revenue model usually has a reason to.",
      "moneyP2": "On bills, we earn a <1>small margin</1> — typically ₦10 to ₦20 on a ₦1,000 purchase — built into the price you see. There is no separate fee added at checkout, and the amount you're shown is the amount you pay.",
      "moneyP3": "On the Marketplace and Home Services, we earn from <1>optional paid plans</1>: sellers can subscribe for more listings and featured placement, and artisans can boost their profile to appear higher in search. Listing and messaging are free.",
      "moneyP4": "On travel, we earn a <1>referral commission</1> from booking partners at no extra cost to you.",
      "safetyTitle": "How we handle safety",
      "safetyP1": "Phone numbers on the Marketplace and Home Services are <1>never published</1>. They're exchanged only once a seller or artisan accepts your enquiry — so nobody's number sits on a public page waiting to be harvested, and you only ever get the contact details of someone who has actually agreed to deal with you.",
      "safetyP2": "Payments are processed by <1>Paystack</1>. Card details are entered on Paystack's own secure checkout and are never seen or stored by OAM.",
      "noteBody": "<1>A note on where we are.</1> OAM is newly launched, so some sections — particularly the Marketplace and the artisan directory — are still filling up. Coverage grows as more people join, and we'd rather say so than pretend otherwise.",
      "createAccount": "Create an account",
      "talkToUs": "Talk to us"
    },
    "contact": {
      "title": "Contact us",
      "intro": "Something gone wrong, or a question before you start? Here's how to reach a person.",
      "emailTitle": "Email",
      "emailBody": "The fastest route for anything to do with a payment, a missing token, or an account problem.",
      "paymentTitle": "If a payment has gone wrong",
      "paymentP1": "<1>Please don't pay twice.</1> If an order shows as \"processing\", the money has already left and the purchase is with your provider — buying again usually means paying for the same thing a second time.",
      "paymentList": "Instead, email us with:",
      "paymentLi1": "the <1>reference number</1> from the order (it starts with BILL-, FUND- or TRF-)",
      "paymentLi2": "the email address on your OAM account",
      "paymentLi3": "roughly when it happened",
      "paymentP2": "That's usually enough for us to find the transaction and tell you exactly where it is. You can find the reference under <1>Order history</1>.",
      "mktTitle": "Buying or selling on the Marketplace",
      "mktP1": "Questions about a specific item or job are best asked <1>directly in the chat</1> attached to that listing or artisan profile — the other person gets notified, and there's a record of what was agreed.",
      "mktP2": "Contact us instead if someone asks you to pay outside OAM, pressures you for money in advance, or behaves in a way that doesn't feel right. We'd rather hear about it early.",
      "responseTitle": "Response times",
      "responseBody": "We aim to reply to every email within <1>one working day</1>. Payment problems are looked at first. If you haven't heard back after two working days, reply to your own email to bump it — it's more reliable than sending a new one.",
      "scamBody": "<1>We will never ask for your password, card PIN, or a one-time code.</1> Anyone who does — by call, SMS or WhatsApp — is not from OAM, however convincing they sound. Hang up and email us instead.",
      "phoneTitle": "Phone",
      "phoneBody": "Available during working hours for urgent matters. Email is faster for payment and account issues.",
      "addressTitle": "Address",
      "addressBody": "Our registered office. Please email or call ahead before visiting.",
      "formTitle": "Send us a message",
      "formName": "Your name",
      "formEmail": "Your email",
      "formMessage": "Message",
      "submit": "Send message",
      "thanks": "Thanks — your message is ready to send from your email app. We'll reply as soon as we can."
    },
    "help": {
      "title": "Help centre",
      "intro": "Answers to the things people ask most — starting with the one that matters when money is involved.",
      "searchPlaceholder": "Search help…",
      "noMatch": "Nothing matches \"{{query}}\". Email <1>oamapp26@gmail.com</1> and a person will answer.",
      "stillStuck": "Still stuck? Email <1>oamapp26@gmail.com</1> with your order reference and we'll look it up. See <2>Contact</2> for what to include.",
      "groups": {
        "electricity": {
          "title": "Electricity tokens",
          "q1": "I paid for units but no token appeared. What now?",
          "a1p1": "<1>Don't buy again.</1> Your payment has gone through and the order is with your provider — buying a second time charges you twice for the same meter.",
          "a1p2": "Open <1>Order history</1>. While an order is still completing you'll see \"Token on the way\", and the page checks with your provider every few seconds. Tokens usually arrive within a minute or two, occasionally longer at busy times.",
          "a1p3": "The token is also emailed to you as soon as it's issued, so you'll get it even if you've closed the app.",
          "q2": "Where can I find an old token?",
          "a2": "Every token is stored permanently in <1>Order history</1> — open the order and it's there with a copy button. It's also in the receipt email we sent at the time.",
          "q3": "The meter number wasn't accepted.",
          "a3": "Nigerian prepaid meters are <1>11 digits</1>. We only check with your disco once all 11 are entered, so a message while you're still typing just means we're waiting. If a complete number is still rejected, check you've picked the right disco — a valid meter on the wrong disco will always fail."
        },
        "wallet": {
          "title": "Wallet and payments",
          "q1": "Why does my card payment go into my wallet first?",
          "a1p1": "Card payments credit your wallet, and the wallet then pays for what you bought. It looks like an extra step, and it's deliberate.",
          "a1p2": "If a delivery fails, the money is already sitting safely in your wallet as a balance you can spend or withdraw. Paying a provider directly would leave your money stranded between the card processor and them, with no clean way back.",
          "q2": "Are there hidden fees?",
          "a2": "No. The total shown before you pay is what you pay — the fee line reads ₦0 because there isn't one. Our margin is built into the price of bills, so nothing is added at checkout.",
          "q3": "How long do withdrawals take?",
          "a3": "Bank transfers usually land within minutes, though they can take longer during bank downtime. If a withdrawal fails, the amount is returned to your wallet automatically — it isn't lost, and you can try again.",
          "q4": "Can I send money to another OAM user?",
          "a4": "Yes — <1>Transfer</1> moves money between OAM wallets instantly and free. Enter their email or phone number and their name appears before you confirm. <2>Check that name carefully</2>: completed transfers can't be reversed."
        },
        "marketplace": {
          "title": "Marketplace and artisans",
          "q1": "Why can't I see a seller's phone number?",
          "a1p1": "Numbers are never published. Send a message about the item, and once the seller accepts, you'll both see each other's contact details.",
          "a1p2": "It's slightly slower, and it's the single most effective protection we can offer: published numbers get scraped, and scraped numbers get used for impersonation scams.",
          "q2": "How many things can I list for free?",
          "a2": "Three active listings, indefinitely, with no card required. Premium (₦2,500) adds up to 20 listings plus featured placement, and Pro (₦5,000) is unlimited.",
          "q3": "How do I stay safe buying and selling?",
          "a3li1": "Meet in a public place during daylight",
          "a3li2": "Inspect the item before any money changes hands",
          "a3li3": "Never send money in advance to someone you haven't met",
          "a3li4": "Keep the conversation in OAM, so there's a record of what was agreed",
          "a3li5": "Treat any request to move to WhatsApp \"for a better price\" as a warning sign",
          "q4": "What does boosting an artisan profile do?",
          "a4": "It places your profile above unboosted ones in search results, where most people look. Premium is ₦2,500 for 30 days and Pro is ₦5,000 for 90. Both are <1>one-off payments</1> — nothing renews automatically."
        },
        "account": {
          "title": "Account",
          "q1": "Can I use the same account to buy and to sell?",
          "a1": "Yes. One account does everything — you might sell a fridge and hire a plumber in the same week. Your messages are split into \"My enquiries\" and \"Enquiries to me\" so the two don't get tangled.",
          "q2": "Is my card stored on OAM?",
          "a2": "No. Card details are entered on Paystack's secure checkout and are never seen or stored by us."
        }
      }
    },
    "privacy": {
      "title": "Privacy Policy",
      "intro": "What we collect, why, who else sees it, and what you can ask us to do about it.",
      "updated": "23 July 2026",
      "controlTitle": "Who controls your data",
      "controlBody": "<1>O.A.M Motors Limited</1> (RC <2>8034525</2>) is the data controller. For any privacy question or request, email <3>oamapp26@gmail.com</3>.",
      "collectTitle": "What we collect",
      "collectGive": "You give us:",
      "giveLi1": "Name, email address and phone number when you register",
      "giveLi2": "Bank account details when you set up a withdrawal",
      "giveLi3": "Meter numbers, smartcard numbers and phone numbers you pay bills for",
      "giveLi4": "Listing details, artisan profile details, and the contact numbers on them",
      "giveLi5": "Messages you send to other users through OAM",
      "collectCreated": "Created as you use OAM:",
      "createdLi1": "Wallet balance and full transaction history",
      "createdLi2": "Orders, references, and electricity tokens issued to you",
      "createdLi3": "Approximate location, if you allow it, to find artisans near you",
      "collectCard": "<1>We never see or store your card details.</1> Cards are entered on Paystack's own checkout and stay with them.",
      "whyTitle": "Why we use it",
      "whyLi1": "<1>To run your account and process payments</1> — we can't deliver airtime or units without the number or meter",
      "whyLi2": "<1>To send receipts and tokens</1> by email, so a delivered token isn't lost when you close the app",
      "whyLi3": "<1>To connect buyers and sellers</1> — contact details are released only when an enquiry is accepted",
      "whyLi4": "<1>To prevent fraud</1> and investigate misuse",
      "whyLi5": "<1>To meet legal and regulatory obligations</1>, including financial record-keeping",
      "whyNoSell": "We do <1>not</1> sell your personal data, and we don't show advertising based on it.",
      "whoTitle": "Who else sees it",
      "whoIntro": "Only what each partner needs to do their job:",
      "whoLi1": "<1>Paystack</1> — payments and withdrawals; they receive your name, email and payment details",
      "whoLi2": "<1>Bill providers</1> — the phone number, meter or smartcard number for that purchase",
      "whoLi3": "<1>Other OAM users</1> — your name and, once you accept an enquiry, your contact number",
      "whoLi4": "<1>Travel partners</1> — if you follow a booking link, their own privacy policy applies from that point",
      "whoLi5": "<1>Regulators or law enforcement</1> — where we're legally required to disclose",
      "contactTitle": "Contact details on listings and profiles",
      "contactP1": "The number on your listing or artisan profile is <1>not published publicly</1>. It's held privately and released to one specific person only when you accept their enquiry.",
      "contactP2": "This is deliberate: numbers on public pages get harvested and reused for impersonation scams. Keeping the release under your control is the single most useful protection we can offer, so it's built into the product rather than left as a setting.",
      "keepTitle": "How long we keep it",
      "keepP1": "Account and transaction records are kept while your account is open, and for a period afterwards to meet financial record-keeping obligations.",
      "keepP2": "Messages between users are kept while both accounts remain open.",
      "rightsTitle": "Your rights",
      "rightsIntro": "Under the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 you can ask us to:",
      "rightsLi1": "show you the personal data we hold about you",
      "rightsLi2": "correct anything inaccurate",
      "rightsLi3": "delete data we no longer have a lawful reason to keep",
      "rightsLi4": "stop using your data for a particular purpose",
      "rightsLi5": "provide your data in a portable form",
      "rightsEmail": "Email <1>oamapp26@gmail.com</1>. We'll respond within one month.",
      "rightsKeep": "Some data we must keep even after you ask — completed financial transactions, for instance, where the law requires a record. We'll tell you if that applies.",
      "securityTitle": "Security",
      "securityP1": "Passwords are stored hashed, never in readable form. Payments go through Paystack's secure checkout. Access to customer data inside OAM is limited to the people who need it to run the service.",
      "securityP2": "No system is perfectly secure. If a breach affects your data, we'll tell you and the regulator as the law requires.",
      "changesTitle": "Changes",
      "changesBody": "If we change this policy materially, we'll notify you by email or in the app before it takes effect. See also our <1>Terms of Service</1>."
    },
    "terms": {
      "title": "Terms of Service",
      "intro": "The agreement between you and O.A.M Motors Limited when you use OAM.",
      "updated": "23 July 2026",
      "s1Title": "1. Who we are",
      "s1Body": "OAM is operated by <1>O.A.M Motors Limited</1>, a company registered in Nigeria (RC <2>8034525</2>), registered address <3>Block Shop 11, No 2, Akinwunmi Street, Ojo, Lagos, Nigeria</3>. In these terms \"we\", \"us\" and \"OAM\" mean that company; \"you\" means the account holder.",
      "s2Title": "2. Your account",
      "s2P1": "You must be <1>18 or over</1> and provide accurate details. One person, one account. You are responsible for keeping your password and one-time codes private — we will never ask you for them, and anyone who does is not from OAM.",
      "s2P2": "Tell us immediately at <1>oamapp26@gmail.com</1> if you believe someone else has access to your account.",
      "s3Title": "3. Your wallet",
      "s3P1": "Your wallet balance is money we hold for you. It is not a bank deposit, it earns no interest, and it is not covered by deposit insurance.",
      "s3P2": "You can withdraw your balance to a bank account in your own name at any time, subject to the checks below. Card payments credit your wallet first and the wallet then pays for your purchase — so if a delivery fails, the money remains yours as a wallet balance.",
      "s3P3": "<1>Transfers between OAM users are final.</1> Check the recipient's name, shown before you confirm, because a completed transfer cannot be reversed.",
      "s4Title": "4. Bills, airtime and electricity",
      "s4P1": "We buy these from licensed third-party providers on your instruction. The price you are shown is the price you pay; our margin is included in it and no separate fee is added.",
      "s4P2": "<1>Check the recipient before you confirm.</1> Airtime sent to a mistyped number, or units sent to the wrong meter, generally cannot be recovered — the value has already been delivered to that number or meter.",
      "s4P3": "Where a purchase fails at the provider, the amount is returned to your wallet. Where a provider is delayed, the order remains open until it settles; buying again during a delay means paying twice, and we cannot refund a duplicate purchase you chose to make.",
      "s5Title": "5. Marketplace and Home Services",
      "s5P1": "<1>OAM is not a party to these deals.</1> We provide the listing and the messaging; the agreement is between buyer and seller, or customer and artisan. We do not verify items, inspect work, hold payment in escrow, or guarantee quality.",
      "s5P2": "You are responsible for what you list, and for meeting your side of anything you agree. Contact details are exchanged only when a seller or artisan accepts an enquiry.",
      "s5ListIntro": "You may not list, among other things:",
      "s5Li1": "anything illegal to sell in Nigeria",
      "s5Li2": "weapons, controlled drugs, or counterfeit goods",
      "s5Li3": "stolen property, or anything you don't have the right to sell",
      "s5Li4": "services you are not qualified or licensed to provide",
      "s5P3": "We may remove listings and suspend accounts where these terms are broken. Paid plan fees are generally not refundable where an account is suspended for breach.",
      "s6Title": "6. Paid plans and boosts",
      "s6P1": "Seller subscriptions (Premium and Pro) and artisan boosts are <1>one-off payments</1> for a stated period. They do not renew automatically, and no card is stored for future charges.",
      "s6P2": "Featured placement improves where you appear in search. It does not guarantee sales, enquiries, or any particular level of interest.",
      "s6P3": "Prices may change; any change applies to new purchases, not to a period you have already paid for.",
      "s7Title": "7. Travel bookings",
      "s7Body": "Flights, hotels, car hire and airport transfers are booked with <1>third-party partners</1>, on their sites and under their terms. Your contract for those bookings is with them, not with OAM. We earn a referral commission at no extra cost to you.",
      "s8Title": "8. Things we can't promise",
      "s8P1": "We work to keep OAM available and accurate, but we depend on banks, card processors and utility providers whose systems occasionally fail. We do not promise uninterrupted service.",
      "s8P2": "Nothing here limits our liability for fraud, or for anything that cannot lawfully be limited under Nigerian law.",
      "s9Title": "9. Closing your account",
      "s9P1": "You may close your account at any time; withdraw your balance first, as we may need to complete identity checks before releasing funds.",
      "s9P2": "We may suspend or close an account where we reasonably suspect fraud, illegal use, or a serious breach of these terms. Where we do, we will return any balance that is rightfully yours, subject to any legal obligation preventing it.",
      "s10Title": "10. Changes, law and disputes",
      "s10P1": "We may update these terms. Material changes will be notified by email or in the app before they take effect.",
      "s10P2": "These terms are governed by the laws of the <1>Federal Republic of Nigeria</1>. Please contact us first — most problems are settled quickly by email.",
      "s10P3": "See also our <1>Privacy Policy</1>.",
      "s7P1": "Flights, hotels, car hire and airport transfers are booked with third-party travel partners. Your booking contract is with that partner and is subject to their terms, fares and cancellation rules — OAM helps you find and reach them, but is not the travel provider.",
      "s11Title": "11. Governing law",
      "s11P1": "These terms are governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, and any dispute is subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Nigerian courts.",
      "s12Title": "12. Contact us",
      "s12P1": "Questions about these terms? Email <1>oamapp26@gmail.com</1> and we'll get back to you."
    },
    "refund": {
      "title": "Refund Policy",
      "intro": "How refunds work on OAM, and what to do if a transaction goes wrong.",
      "updated": "11 September 2026",
      "s1Title": "1. Scope",
      "s1P1": "This policy covers payments you make on OAM — wallet funding, airtime and data, electricity and cable, transfers, bus tickets, betting top-ups and other services. Purchases completed on a partner's own website or app (for example travel bookings and e-commerce stores) are governed by that partner's refund terms, not this policy.",
      "s2Title": "2. Successful transactions",
      "s2P1": "Bills, airtime, data, tokens, top-ups and similar services are delivered instantly and are generally non-refundable once the value has been delivered to the number, meter or account you provided.",
      "s2P2": "Always double-check the recipient details before you pay. Value delivered to a wrong-but-valid number or meter that you entered cannot be recovered by OAM.",
      "s3Title": "3. Failed or incomplete transactions",
      "s3P1": "If your wallet or card is debited but the service is not delivered, the amount is automatically reversed to your OAM wallet, usually within minutes.",
      "s3P2": "If a reversal has not appeared after 24 hours, contact us with the transaction reference and we will investigate and resolve it.",
      "s4Title": "4. Wallet funding and withdrawals",
      "s4P1": "Money added to your OAM wallet is held as your balance and can be used across the app or withdrawn to your own Nigerian bank account.",
      "s4P2": "If a funding attempt is charged by your bank but does not reflect in your wallet, it is reversed automatically once the payment provider settles; if it does not, contact us and we will reconcile it.",
      "s5Title": "5. Duplicate or wrong payments",
      "s5P1": "If you were charged more than once for the same order, or a payment clearly failed on the provider's side, the extra charge is refunded to your wallet after verification.",
      "s5P2": "Refunds are made to your OAM wallet by default. Where a refund to your bank card or account is required, it follows the payment provider's timelines.",
      "s6Title": "6. Marketplace, artisans and third parties",
      "s6P1": "OAM connects buyers and sellers and helps you find artisans, but it is not a party to those deals. Payments you make directly to another user, seller or service provider are between you and them; OAM does not refund such payments, though we will help where we reasonably can.",
      "s7Title": "7. How to request a refund",
      "s7P1": "To raise a refund or report a transaction issue, email <1>oamapp26@gmail.com</1> with your registered email or phone, the transaction reference, the date and amount, and a short description. Our team reviews requests and responds as quickly as possible.",
      "s8Title": "8. Changes to this policy",
      "s8P1": "We may update this Refund Policy from time to time. The date at the top shows when it was last changed, and continued use of OAM means you accept the current version."
    }
  },

      "moneyP1": "Creemos que deberías saberlo, porque un servicio que oculta su modelo de ingresos suele tener un motivo.",
      "moneyP2": "En las facturas ganamos un <1>pequeño margen</1> — normalmente de 10 a 20 ₦ en una compra de 1.000 ₦ — incluido en el precio que ves. No se añade ninguna comisión aparte al pagar, y la cantidad que se te muestra es la que pagas.",
      "moneyP3": "En el Mercado y los Servicios para el hogar ganamos con <1>planes de pago opcionales</1>: los vendedores pueden suscribirse para más anuncios y destaque, y los artesanos pueden impulsar su perfil para aparecer más arriba. Publicar y enviar mensajes es gratis.",

      "safetyP2": "Los pagos los procesa <1>Paystack</1>. Los datos de la tarjeta se introducen en la propia página segura de Paystack y OAM nunca los ve ni los almacena.",
      "noteBody": "<1>Una nota sobre dónde estamos.</1> OAM acaba de lanzarse, así que algunas secciones — en particular el Mercado y el directorio de artesanos — aún se están llenando. La cobertura crece a medida que se une más gente, y preferimos decirlo a fingir lo contrario.",

      "mktP1": "Las preguntas sobre un artículo o trabajo concreto es mejor hacerlas <1>directamente en el chat</1> asociado a ese anuncio o perfil de artesano — la otra persona recibe una notificación y queda constancia de lo acordado.",
      "mktP2": "Contáctanos en cambio si alguien te pide pagar fuera de OAM, te presiona para pagar por adelantado o se comporta de una forma que no te da buena espina. Preferimos enterarnos pronto.",

      "searchPlaceholder": "Buscar ayuda…",
      "noMatch": "Nada coincide con «{{query}}». Escribe a <1>oamapp26@gmail.com</1> y una persona responderá.",
      "stillStuck": "¿Sigues atascado? Escribe a <1>oamapp26@gmail.com</1> con tu referencia de pedido y la buscaremos. Consulta <2>Contacto</2> para saber qué incluir.",

          "q1": "Pagué unidades pero no apareció ningún token. ¿Y ahora?",
          "a1p1": "<1>No compres de nuevo.</1> Tu pago se realizó y el pedido está con tu proveedor — comprar por segunda vez te cobra dos veces por el mismo medidor.",
          "a1p2": "Abre el <1>historial de pedidos</1>. Mientras un pedido se completa verás «Token en camino», y la página consulta a tu proveedor cada pocos segundos. Los tokens suelen llegar en un minuto o dos, a veces más en horas punta.",
          "a1p3": "El token también se te envía por correo en cuanto se emite, así que lo recibirás aunque hayas cerrado la app.",

          "q3": "El número de medidor no fue aceptado.",

          "a2": "No. El total mostrado antes de pagar es lo que pagas — la línea de comisión indica ₦0 porque no hay ninguna. Nuestro margen está incluido en el precio de las facturas, así que no se añade nada al pagar.",

      "createdLi1": "Saldo del monedero e historial completo de transacciones",
      "createdLi2": "Pedidos, referencias y tokens de electricidad emitidos a ti",
      "createdLi3": "Ubicación aproximada, si lo permites, para encontrar artesanos cerca de ti",
      "collectCard": "<1>Nunca vemos ni almacenamos los datos de tu tarjeta.</1> Las tarjetas se introducen en el pago de Paystack y quedan con ellos.",
      "whyTitle": "Por qué los usamos",
      "whyLi1": "<1>Para gestionar tu cuenta y procesar pagos</1> — no podemos entregar saldo ni unidades sin el número o el medidor",
      "whyLi2": "<1>Para enviar recibos y tokens</1> por correo, para que un token entregado no se pierda al cerrar la app",
      "whyLi3": "<1>Para conectar a compradores y vendedores</1> — los datos de contacto se liberan solo cuando se acepta una consulta",
      "whyLi4": "<1>Para prevenir el fraude</1> e investigar el mal uso",
      "whyLi5": "<1>Para cumplir obligaciones legales y regulatorias</1>, incluido el mantenimiento de registros financieros",
      "whyNoSell": "<1>No</1> vendemos tus datos personales, y no mostramos publicidad basada en ellos.",
      "whoTitle": "Quién más lo ve",
      "whoIntro": "Solo lo que cada socio necesita para hacer su trabajo:",
      "whoLi1": "<1>Paystack</1> — pagos y retiros; reciben tu nombre, correo y datos de pago",
      "whoLi2": "<1>Proveedores de facturas</1> — el número de teléfono, medidor o tarjeta inteligente de esa compra",
      "whoLi3": "<1>Otros usuarios de OAM</1> — tu nombre y, una vez que aceptas una consulta, tu número de contacto",
      "whoLi4": "<1>Socios de viajes</1> — si sigues un enlace de reserva, su propia política de privacidad se aplica desde ese punto",
      "whoLi5": "<1>Reguladores o autoridades</1> — cuando la ley nos obliga a divulgar",
      "contactTitle": "Datos de contacto en anuncios y perfiles",
      "contactP1": "El número de tu anuncio o perfil de artesano <1>no se publica públicamente</1>. Se guarda de forma privada y se comparte con una persona concreta solo cuando aceptas su consulta.",
      "contactP2": "Es deliberado: los números en páginas públicas se recopilan y reutilizan para estafas de suplantación. Mantener esa liberación bajo tu control es la protección más útil que podemos ofrecer, por eso está integrada en el producto y no dejada como un ajuste.",
      "keepTitle": "Cuánto tiempo los conservamos",
      "keepP1": "Los registros de cuenta y transacciones se conservan mientras tu cuenta esté abierta, y por un periodo posterior para cumplir las obligaciones de registros financieros.",
      "keepP2": "Los mensajes entre usuarios se conservan mientras ambas cuentas sigan abiertas.",
      "rightsTitle": "Tus derechos",
      "rightsIntro": "Bajo la Ley de Protección de Datos de Nigeria de 2023 puedes pedirnos:",
      "rightsLi1": "mostrarte los datos personales que tenemos sobre ti",
      "rightsLi2": "corregir cualquier inexactitud",
      "rightsLi3": "eliminar datos que ya no tengamos motivo legal para conservar",
      "rightsLi4": "dejar de usar tus datos para un fin concreto",
      "rightsLi5": "proporcionar tus datos en un formato portable",
      "rightsEmail": "Escribe a <1>oamapp26@gmail.com</1>. Responderemos en un mes.",
      "rightsKeep": "Algunos datos debemos conservarlos incluso tras tu solicitud — las transacciones financieras completadas, por ejemplo, cuando la ley exige un registro. Te lo diremos si aplica.",
      "securityTitle": "Seguridad",
      "securityP1": "Las contraseñas se almacenan con hash, nunca en forma legible. Los pagos pasan por el pago seguro de Paystack. El acceso a los datos de clientes dentro de OAM se limita a quienes lo necesitan para operar el servicio.",
      "securityP2": "Ningún sistema es perfectamente seguro. Si una brecha afecta a tus datos, te lo diremos a ti y al regulador según exige la ley.",
      "changesTitle": "Cambios",
      "changesBody": "Si cambiamos esta política de forma sustancial, te lo notificaremos por correo o en la app antes de que entre en vigor. Consulta también nuestros <1>Términos del servicio</1>."
    },
    "terms": {
      "title": "Términos del servicio",
      "intro": "El acuerdo entre tú y O.A.M Motors Limited cuando usas OAM.",
      "updated": "23 de julio de 2026",
      "s1Title": "1. Quiénes somos",
      "s1Body": "OAM es operado por <1>O.A.M Motors Limited</1>, una empresa registrada en Nigeria (RC <2>8034525</2>), domicilio registrado <3>Block Shop 11, No 2, Akinwunmi Street, Ojo, Lagos, Nigeria</3>. En estos términos «nosotros» y «OAM» significan esa empresa; «tú» significa el titular de la cuenta.",
      "s2Title": "2. Tu cuenta",
      "s2P1": "Debes tener <1>18 años o más</1> y proporcionar datos exactos. Una persona, una cuenta. Eres responsable de mantener privados tu contraseña y códigos de un solo uso — nunca te los pediremos, y quien lo haga no es de OAM.",
      "s2P2": "Avísanos de inmediato a <1>oamapp26@gmail.com</1> si crees que otra persona tiene acceso a tu cuenta.",
      "s3Title": "3. Tu monedero",
      "s3P1": "El saldo de tu monedero es dinero que guardamos por ti. No es un depósito bancario, no genera intereses y no está cubierto por seguro de depósitos.",
      "s3P2": "Puedes retirar tu saldo a una cuenta bancaria a tu nombre en cualquier momento, sujeto a las verificaciones siguientes. Los pagos con tarjeta acreditan primero tu monedero, y este paga tu compra — así que si una entrega falla, el dinero sigue siendo tuyo como saldo.",
      "s3P3": "<1>Las transferencias entre usuarios de OAM son definitivas.</1> Verifica el nombre del destinatario, mostrado antes de confirmar, porque una transferencia completada no se puede revertir.",
      "s4Title": "4. Facturas, saldo y electricidad",
      "s4P1": "Los compramos a proveedores externos autorizados según tu instrucción. El precio que se te muestra es el que pagas; nuestro margen está incluido y no se añade ninguna comisión aparte.",
      "s4P2": "<1>Verifica el destinatario antes de confirmar.</1> El saldo enviado a un número mal escrito, o unidades enviadas al medidor equivocado, generalmente no se pueden recuperar — el valor ya se entregó a ese número o medidor.",
      "s4P3": "Cuando una compra falla en el proveedor, el importe vuelve a tu monedero. Cuando un proveedor se retrasa, el pedido queda abierto hasta liquidarse; comprar de nuevo durante un retraso significa pagar dos veces, y no podemos reembolsar una compra duplicada que elegiste hacer.",
      "s5Title": "5. Mercado y servicios a domicilio",
      "s5P1": "<1>OAM no es parte de estos tratos.</1> Proporcionamos el anuncio y la mensajería; el acuerdo es entre comprador y vendedor, o cliente y artesano. No verificamos artículos, no inspeccionamos trabajos, no retenemos pagos en depósito ni garantizamos la calidad.",
      "s5P2": "Eres responsable de lo que publicas y de cumplir tu parte de cualquier acuerdo. Los datos de contacto se intercambian solo cuando un vendedor o artesano acepta una consulta.",
      "s5ListIntro": "No puedes publicar, entre otras cosas:",
      "s5Li1": "nada ilegal de vender en Nigeria",
      "s5Li2": "armas, drogas controladas o productos falsificados",
      "s5Li3": "bienes robados, o cualquier cosa que no tengas derecho a vender",
      "s5Li4": "servicios que no estás cualificado ni autorizado a prestar",
      "s5P3": "Podemos retirar anuncios y suspender cuentas cuando se incumplan estos términos. Las tarifas de los planes de pago generalmente no son reembolsables cuando se suspende una cuenta por incumplimiento.",
      "s6Title": "6. Planes de pago y promociones",
      "s6P1": "Las suscripciones de vendedor (Premium y Pro) y las promociones de artesano son <1>pagos únicos</1> por un periodo indicado. No se renuevan automáticamente y no se guarda ninguna tarjeta para cargos futuros.",
      "s6P2": "La colocación destacada mejora dónde apareces en la búsqueda. No garantiza ventas, consultas ni ningún nivel concreto de interés.",
      "s6P3": "Los precios pueden cambiar; cualquier cambio se aplica a nuevas compras, no a un periodo que ya hayas pagado.",
      "s7Title": "7. Reservas de viaje",
      "s7Body": "Vuelos, hoteles, alquiler de coches y traslados al aeropuerto se reservan con <1>socios externos</1>, en sus sitios y bajo sus términos. Tu contrato por esas reservas es con ellos, no con OAM. Ganamos una comisión de referido sin coste adicional para ti.",
      "s8Title": "8. Cosas que no podemos prometer",
      "s8P1": "Trabajamos para mantener OAM disponible y exacto, pero dependemos de bancos, procesadores de tarjetas y proveedores de servicios cuyos sistemas fallan a veces. No prometemos un servicio ininterrumpido.",
      "s8P2": "Nada aquí limita nuestra responsabilidad por fraude, ni por nada que no pueda limitarse legalmente bajo la ley nigeriana.",
      "s9Title": "9. Cerrar tu cuenta",
      "s9P1": "Puedes cerrar tu cuenta en cualquier momento; retira primero tu saldo, ya que podríamos necesitar completar verificaciones de identidad antes de liberar los fondos.",
      "s9P2": "Podemos suspender o cerrar una cuenta cuando sospechemos razonablemente fraude, uso ilegal o un incumplimiento grave de estos términos. Cuando lo hagamos, devolveremos cualquier saldo que legítimamente te corresponda, sujeto a cualquier obligación legal que lo impida.",
      "s10Title": "10. Cambios, ley y disputas",
      "s10P1": "Podemos actualizar estos términos. Los cambios importantes se notificarán por correo o en la app antes de entrar en vigor.",
      "s10P2": "Estos términos se rigen por las leyes de la <1>República Federal de Nigeria</1>. Contáctanos primero — la mayoría de los problemas se resuelven rápido por correo.",
      "s10P3": "Consulta también nuestra <1>Política de privacidad</1>."
    }
  },

      "moneyP1": "Nous pensons que vous devez le savoir, car un service qui cache son modèle de revenus a généralement une raison de le faire.",
      "moneyP2": "Sur les factures, nous gagnons une <1>petite marge</1> — généralement 10 à 20 ₦ sur un achat de 1 000 ₦ — intégrée au prix affiché. Aucun frais séparé n'est ajouté au paiement, et le montant affiché est celui que vous payez.",
      "moneyP3": "Sur le Marché et les Services à domicile, nous gagnons grâce à des <1>forfaits payants optionnels</1> : les vendeurs peuvent s'abonner pour plus d'annonces et une mise en avant, et les artisans peuvent booster leur profil pour apparaître plus haut.       "safetyP2": "Les paiements sont traités par <1>Paystack</1>. Les données de carte sont saisies sur la page de paiement sécurisée de Paystack et ne sont jamais vues ni stockées par OAM.",

          "a3": "Les compteurs prépayés nigérians ont <1>11 chiffres</1>. Si un numéro complet est toujours rejeté, vérifiez d'avoir choisi le bon disco — un compteur valide sur le mauvais disco échouera toujours."
        },
        "wallet": {
          "title": "Portefeuille et paiements",
          "q1": "Pourquoi mon paiement par carte va-t-il d'abord dans mon portefeuille ?",
          "a1p1": "Les paiements par carte créditent votre portefeuille, qui règle ensuite votre achat. Cela ressemble à une étape en plus, et c'est délibéré.",
          "a1p2": "Si une livraison échoue, l'argent est déjà en sécurité dans votre portefeuille, un solde que vous pouvez dépenser ou retirer. Payer un fournisseur directement laisserait votre argent bloqué entre le processeur de carte et lui, sans retour propre.",
          "q2": "Y a-t-il des frais cachés ?",
          "a2": "Non. Le total affiché avant de payer est ce que vous payez — la ligne de frais indique ₦0 car il n'y en a pas. Notre marge est intégrée au prix des factures, donc rien n'est ajouté au paiement.",
          "q3": "Combien de temps prennent les retraits ?",
          "a3": "Les virements bancaires arrivent généralement en quelques minutes, mais peuvent prendre plus longtemps lors d'indisponibilités bancaires. Si un retrait échoue, le montant est automatiquement renvoyé dans votre portefeuille — il n'est pas perdu, et vous pouvez réessayer.",
          "q4": "Puis-je envoyer de l'argent à un autre utilisateur OAM ?",
          "a4": "Oui — <1>Transfert</1> déplace de l'argent entre portefeuilles OAM instantanément et gratuitement. Saisissez leur e-mail ou numéro et leur nom apparaît avant confirmation. <2>Vérifiez ce nom attentivement</2> : les transferts effectués ne peuvent pas être annulés."
        },
        "marketplace": {
          "title": "Marché et artisans",
          "q1": "Pourquoi ne puis-je pas voir le numéro d'un vendeur ?",
          "a1p1": "Les numéros ne sont jamais publiés. Envoyez un message au sujet de l'article, et une fois que le vendeur accepte, vous verrez tous les deux vos coordonnées.",
          "a1p2": "C'est légèrement plus lent, et c'est la protection la plus efficace que nous puissions offrir : les numéros publiés sont collectés, et les numéros collectés servent aux arnaques par usurpation.",
          "q2": "Combien d'articles puis-je publier gratuitement ?",
          "a2": "Trois annonces actives, indéfiniment, sans carte requise. Premium (₦2,500) ajoute jusqu'à 20 annonces plus un placement en vedette, et Pro (₦5,000) est illimité.",
          "q3": "Comment rester en sécurité en achetant et vendant ?",
          "a3li1": "Rencontrez-vous dans un lieu public en journée",
          "a3li2": "Inspectez l'article avant tout échange d'argent",
          "a3li3": "N'envoyez jamais d'argent à l'avance à quelqu'un que vous n'avez pas rencontré",
          "a3li4": "Gardez la conversation dans OAM, pour garder une trace de ce qui a été convenu",
          "a3li5": "Considérez toute demande de passer sur WhatsApp « pour un meilleur prix » comme un signal d'alerte",
          "q4": "À quoi sert la mise en avant d'un profil d'artisan ?",
          "a4": "Elle place votre profil au-dessus des profils non mis en avant dans les résultats, là où la plupart regardent. Premium coûte ₦2,500 pour 30 jours et Pro ₦5,000 pour 90. Les deux sont des <1>paiements uniques</1> — rien ne se renouvelle automatiquement."
        },
        "account": {
          "title": "Compte",
          "q1": "Puis-je utiliser le même compte pour acheter et vendre ?",
          "a1": "Oui. Un seul compte fait tout — vous pourriez vendre un frigo et engager un plombier la même semaine. Vos messages sont séparés en « Mes demandes » et « Demandes reçues » pour ne pas les mélanger.",
          "q2": "Ma carte est-elle enregistrée sur OAM ?",
          "a2": "Non. Les détails de carte sont saisis sur le paiement sécurisé de Paystack et ne sont jamais vus ni conservés par nous."
        }
      }

    "terms": {
      "title": "Conditions d'utilisation",
      "intro": "L'accord entre vous et O.A.M Motors Limited lorsque vous utilisez OAM.",
      "updated": "23 juillet 2026",
      "s1Title": "1. Qui nous sommes",
      "s1Body": "OAM est exploité par <1>O.A.M Motors Limited</1>, une société immatriculée au Nigeria (RC <2>8034525</2>), adresse enregistrée <3>Block Shop 11, No 2, Akinwunmi Street, Ojo, Lagos, Nigeria</3>. Dans ces conditions, « nous » et « OAM » désignent cette société ; « vous » désigne le titulaire du compte.",
      "s2Title": "2. Votre compte",
      "s2P1": "Vous devez avoir <1>18 ans ou plus</1> et fournir des informations exactes. Une personne, un compte. Vous êtes responsable de garder privés votre mot de passe et vos codes à usage unique — nous ne vous les demanderons jamais, et quiconque le fait n'est pas d'OAM.",
      "s2P2": "Prévenez-nous immédiatement à <1>oamapp26@gmail.com</1> si vous pensez que quelqu'un d'autre a accès à votre compte.",
      "s3Title": "3. Votre portefeuille",
      "s3P1": "Le solde de votre portefeuille est de l'argent que nous détenons pour vous. Ce n'est pas un dépôt bancaire, il ne rapporte pas d'intérêts et n'est pas couvert par une assurance des dépôts.",
      "s3P2": "Vous pouvez retirer votre solde vers un compte bancaire à votre nom à tout moment, sous réserve des vérifications ci-dessous. Les paiements par carte créditent d'abord votre portefeuille, qui paie ensuite votre achat — donc si une livraison échoue, l'argent reste le vôtre en solde de portefeuille.",
      "s3P3": "<1>Les transferts entre utilisateurs OAM sont définitifs.</1> Vérifiez le nom du destinataire, affiché avant confirmation, car un transfert effectué ne peut être annulé.",
      "s4Title": "4. Factures, crédit et électricité",
      "s4P1": "Nous les achetons auprès de fournisseurs tiers agréés sur votre instruction. Le prix affiché est le prix payé ; notre marge y est incluse et aucun frais séparé n'est ajouté.",
      "s4P2": "<1>Vérifiez le destinataire avant de confirmer.</1> Un crédit envoyé à un numéro mal saisi, ou des unités envoyées au mauvais compteur, ne peuvent généralement pas être récupérés — la valeur a déjà été livrée à ce numéro ou compteur.",
      "s4P3": "Lorsqu'un achat échoue chez le fournisseur, le montant est renvoyé dans votre portefeuille. Lorsqu'un fournisseur est en retard, la commande reste ouverte jusqu'à son règlement ; acheter à nouveau pendant un retard revient à payer deux fois, et nous ne pouvons pas rembourser un achat en double que vous avez choisi de faire.",
      "s5Title": "5. Marché et services à domicile",
      "s5P1": "<1>OAM n'est pas partie à ces transactions.</1> Nous fournissons l'annonce et la messagerie ; l'accord est entre acheteur et vendeur, ou client et artisan. Nous ne vérifions pas les articles, n'inspectons pas les travaux, ne conservons pas le paiement en séquestre et ne garantissons pas la qualité.",
      "s5P2": "Vous êtes responsable de ce que vous publiez et de tenir votre part de tout accord. Les coordonnées ne sont échangées que lorsqu'un vendeur ou un artisan accepte une demande.",
      "s5ListIntro": "Vous ne pouvez pas publier, entre autres :",
      "s5Li1": "tout ce qui est illégal à vendre au Nigeria",
      "s5Li2": "armes, drogues contrôlées ou produits contrefaits",
      "s5Li3": "biens volés, ou tout ce que vous n'avez pas le droit de vendre",
      "s5Li4": "services que vous n'êtes ni qualifié ni autorisé à fournir",
      "s5P3": "Nous pouvons retirer des annonces et suspendre des comptes en cas de violation de ces conditions. Les frais des forfaits payants ne sont généralement pas remboursables lorsqu'un compte est suspendu pour manquement.",
      "s6Title": "6. Forfaits payants et mises en avant",
      "s6P1": "Les abonnements vendeur (Premium et Pro) et les mises en avant d'artisan sont des <1>paiements uniques</1> pour une période indiquée. Ils ne se renouvellent pas automatiquement et aucune carte n'est conservée pour des débits futurs.",
      "s6P2": "Le placement en vedette améliore votre position dans la recherche. Il ne garantit ni ventes, ni demandes, ni aucun niveau d'intérêt particulier.",
      "s6P3": "Les prix peuvent changer ; tout changement s'applique aux nouveaux achats, non à une période déjà payée.",
      "s7Title": "7. Réservations de voyage",
      "s7Body": "Vols, hôtels, location de voiture et transferts aéroport sont réservés auprès de <1>partenaires tiers</1>, sur leurs sites et selon leurs conditions. Votre contrat pour ces réservations est avec eux, non avec OAM. Nous percevons une commission d'apporteur sans coût supplémentaire pour vous.",
      "s8Title": "8. Ce que nous ne pouvons pas promettre",
      "s8P1": "Nous nous efforçons de garder OAM disponible et exact, mais nous dépendons de banques, processeurs de cartes et fournisseurs de services publics dont les systèmes tombent parfois en panne. Nous ne promettons pas un service ininterrompu.",
      "s8P2": "Rien ici ne limite notre responsabilité en cas de fraude, ni pour ce qui ne peut légalement être limité selon le droit nigérian.",
      "s9Title": "9. Fermeture de votre compte",
      "s9P1": "Vous pouvez fermer votre compte à tout moment ; retirez d'abord votre solde, car nous pourrions devoir effectuer des vérifications d'identité avant de libérer les fonds.",
      "s9P2": "Nous pouvons suspendre ou fermer un compte lorsque nous soupçonnons raisonnablement une fraude, un usage illégal ou une violation grave de ces conditions. Le cas échéant, nous restituerons tout solde qui vous revient de droit, sous réserve de toute obligation légale l'en empêchant.",
      "s10Title": "10. Modifications, droit et litiges",
      "s10P1": "Nous pouvons mettre à jour ces conditions. Les changements importants seront notifiés par e-mail ou dans l'application avant leur entrée en vigueur.",
      "s10P2": "Ces conditions sont régies par les lois de la <1>République fédérale du Nigeria</1>. Veuillez d'abord nous contacter — la plupart des problèmes se règlent vite par e-mail.",
      "s10P3": "Voir aussi notre <1>Politique de confidentialité</1>."
    }
  },

      "securityTitle": "Tsaro",
      "securityP1": "Ana adana kalmomin sirri a matsayin hash, ba a cikin sigar da za a iya karantawa ba. Biyan kuɗi na wucewa ta shafin biya mai tsaro na Paystack. An iyakance samun bayanan abokan ciniki cikin OAM ga mutanen da suke buƙatarsa don gudanar da sabis.",
      "securityP2": "Babu tsarin da ke da cikakken tsaro. Idan keta ya shafi bayananka, za mu gaya maka da mai tsari kamar yadda doka ta buƙata.",
      "changesTitle": "Canje-canje",
      "changesBody": "Idan mun canza wannan manufa da mahimmanci, za mu sanar da kai ta imel ko a cikin manhajar kafin ta fara aiki. Duba kuma <1>Sharuɗɗan Sabis</1> namu."
    },
    "terms": {
      "title": "Sharuɗɗan Sabis",
      "intro": "Yarjejeniyar da ke tsakaninka da O.A.M Motors Limited lokacin da kake amfani da OAM.",
      "updated": "23 ga Yuli 2026",
      "s1Title": "1. Su wane ne mu",
      "s1Body": "OAM ana gudanar da ita ne ta <1>O.A.M Motors Limited</1>, kamfani da aka yi rajista a Najeriya (RC <2>8034525</2>), adireshin da aka rajista <3>Block Shop 11, No 2, Akinwunmi Street, Ojo, Lagos, Nigeria</3>. A cikin waɗannan sharuɗɗan \"mu\" da \"OAM\" na nufin wannan kamfani; \"kai\" na nufin mai asusu.",
      "s2Title": "2. Asusunka",
      "s2P1": "Dole ka kasance <1>shekaru 18 ko fiye</1> kuma ka bayar da bayanai daidai. Mutum ɗaya, asusu ɗaya. Kai ke da alhakin kiyaye kalmar sirrinka da lambobin sau ɗaya a asirce — ba za mu taɓa neman su ba, kuma duk wanda ya nema ba na OAM ba ne.",
      "s2P2": "Ka gaya mana nan take a <1>oamapp26@gmail.com</1> idan ka yi imani wani yana da damar shiga asusunka.",
      "s3Title": "3. Walat ɗinka",
      "s3P1": "Ma'aunin walat ɗinka kuɗi ne da muke riƙe maka. Ba ajiyar banki ba ne, ba ya samun riba, kuma inshorar ajiya ba ta rufe shi.",
      "s3P2": "Za ka iya cire ma'auninka zuwa asusun banki a sunanka a kowane lokaci, ƙarƙashin dubawar da ke ƙasa. Biyan kati na fara shiga walat ɗinka sannan walat ɗin ya biya sayanka — don haka idan isar da kaya ta gaza, kuɗin na nan naka a matsayin ma'auni.",
      "s3P3": "<1>Turawa tsakanin masu amfani da OAM na ƙarshe ne.</1> Duba sunan mai karɓa, wanda ake nuna kafin ka tabbatar, domin ba a iya juyar da turawar da aka kammala.",
      "s4Title": "4. Kuɗaɗe, airtime da wutar lantarki",
      "s4P1": "Muna sayen waɗannan daga masu bayarwa na waje masu lasisi bisa umarninka. Farashin da aka nuna maka shine abin da kake biya; ribar mu na cikinsa kuma ba a ƙara wani kuɗi na daban.",
      "s4P2": "<1>Duba mai karɓa kafin ka tabbatar.</1> Airtime da aka aika zuwa lamba mara daidai, ko raka'o'i zuwa mita mara kyau, galibi ba a iya dawo da su — an riga an kai darajar zuwa wannan lamba ko mita.",
      "s4P3": "Inda saya ta gaza a wurin mai bayarwa, ana mayar da adadin zuwa walat ɗinka. Inda mai bayarwa ya jinkirta, oda na ci gaba da buɗe har sai an sasanta; saya kuma yayin jinkiri na nufin biya sau biyu, kuma ba za mu iya mayar da kuɗin saya biyu da ka zaɓa ka yi ba.",
      "s5Title": "5. Kasuwa da Sabis na Gida",
      "s5P1": "<1>OAM ba ɓangare a waɗannan cinikai ba ce.</1> Muna bayar da talla da saƙo; yarjejeniya na tsakanin mai saya da mai sayarwa, ko abokin ciniki da ma'aikaci. Ba mu tabbatar da abubuwa, ba mu duba aiki, ba mu riƙe biya a matsayin amana, kuma ba mu tabbatar da inganci.",
      "s5P2": "Kai ke da alhakin abin da ka lissafa, da cika ɓangarenka na duk abin da ka amince. Ana musanya bayanan tuntuɓa ne kawai lokacin da mai sayarwa ko ma'aikaci ya amshi tambaya.",
      "s5ListIntro": "Ba za ka iya lissafa ba, a tsakanin sauran:",
      "s5Li1": "duk abin da doka ta hana sayarwa a Najeriya",
      "s5Li2": "makamai, ƙwayoyi masu kula, ko kayan jabu",
      "s5Li3": "dukiyar da aka sata, ko duk abin da ba ka da hakkin sayarwa",
      "s5Li4": "sabis ɗin da ba ka da cancanta ko lasisin bayarwa",
      "s5P3": "Za mu iya cire tallace-tallace da dakatar da asusai inda aka karya waɗannan sharuɗɗan. Kuɗin tsare-tsaren biya galibi ba a mayar da su inda aka dakatar da asusu don keta.",
      "s6Title": "6. Tsare-tsaren biya da haɓakawa",
      "s6P1": "Biyan kuɗin mai sayarwa (Premium da Pro) da haɓaka ma'aikaci <1>biyan kuɗi ne na sau ɗaya</1> na wani lokaci da aka bayyana. Ba sa sabunta kansu, kuma ba a adana kati don caji na gaba.",
      "s6P2": "Wurin nunawa na musamman na inganta inda kake bayyana a bincike. Ba ya tabbatar da sayarwa, tambayoyi, ko wani matakin sha'awa.",
      "s6P3": "Farashi na iya canzawa; duk canji na shafi sabbin saye, ba lokacin da ka riga ka biya ba.",
      "s7Title": "7. Ajiyar tafiya",
      "s7Body": "Ana yin ajiyar jirage, otal-otal, hayar mota da ɗaukar filin jirgi da <1>abokan haɗin gwiwa na waje</1>, a shafukansu kuma ƙarƙashin sharuɗɗansu. Kwangilarka na waɗannan ajiyoyin da su ce, ba da OAM ba. Muna samun kwamitin turawa ba tare da ƙarin kuɗi a gare ka ba.",
      "s8Title": "8. Abubuwan da ba za mu iya yin alkawari ba",
      "s8P1": "Muna aiki don kiyaye OAM tana samuwa kuma daidai, amma mun dogara da bankuna, masu sarrafa kati da masu ba da amfani waɗanda tsarinsu ke gazawa lokaci-lokaci. Ba mu yin alkawarin sabis mara katsewa.",
      "s8P2": "Babu wani abu a nan da ke iyakance alhakinmu na zamba, ko na duk abin da ba za a iya iyakancewa bisa doka ƙarƙashin dokar Najeriya ba.",
      "s9Title": "9. Rufe asusunka",
      "s9P1": "Za ka iya rufe asusunka a kowane lokaci; cire ma'auninka da farko, saboda muna iya buƙatar kammala dubawar shaida kafin sakin kuɗi.",
      "s9P2": "Za mu iya dakatar ko rufe asusu inda muke da tuhuma mai ma'ana na zamba, amfani ba bisa doka ba, ko babbar keta waɗannan sharuɗɗan. Inda muka yi, za mu mayar da duk ma'aunin da ke naka bisa hakki, ƙarƙashin duk wajibcin doka da ke hana shi.",
      "s10Title": "10. Canje-canje, doka da rigingimu",
      "s10P1": "Za mu iya sabunta waɗannan sharuɗɗan. Za a sanar da manyan canje-canje ta imel ko a cikin manhajar kafin su fara aiki.",
      "s10P2": "Waɗannan sharuɗɗan doka ce ta <1>Jamhuriyar Tarayyar Najeriya</1> ke shugabantar su. Da fatan za ka tuntuɓe mu da farko — ana sasanta yawancin matsaloli da sauri ta imel.",
      "s10P3": "Duba kuma <1>Manufar Sirri</1> namu."
    }
  },

      "s4P3": "जहाँ प्रदाता के पास खरीद विफल हो, राशि आपके वॉलेट में लौट आती है। जहाँ प्रदाता विलंबित हो, ऑर्डर तब तक खुला रहता है जब तक निपट न जाए; विलंब के दौरान दोबारा खरीदने का मतलब दो बार भुगतान, और आपकी चुनी हुई दोहरी खरीद हम वापस नहीं कर सकते।",
      "s5Title": "5. मार्केटप्लेस और गृह सेवाएँ",
      "s5P1": "<1>OAM इन सौदों का पक्षकार नहीं है।</1> हम लिस्टिंग और मैसेजिंग देते हैं; समझौता खरीदार और विक्रेता, या ग्राहक और कारीगर के बीच है। हम वस्तुओं की पुष्टि नहीं करते, काम का निरीक्षण नहीं करते, भुगतान एस्क्रो में नहीं रखते, न गुणवत्ता की गारंटी देते हैं।",
      "s5P2": "आप जो सूचीबद्ध करते हैं और किसी भी सहमति में अपनी ओर से पूरा करने के लिए ज़िम्मेदार हैं। संपर्क विवरण केवल तभी आदान-प्रदान होते हैं जब विक्रेता या कारीगर पूछताछ स्वीकार करता है।",
      "s5ListIntro": "आप अन्य बातों के अलावा ये सूचीबद्ध नहीं कर सकते:",
      "s5Li1": "कुछ भी जो नाइजीरिया में बेचना अवैध है",
      "s5Li2": "हथियार, नियंत्रित दवाएँ, या नकली माल",
      "s5Li3": "चोरी की संपत्ति, या कुछ भी जिसे बेचने का आपको अधिकार नहीं",
      "s5Li4": "ऐसी सेवाएँ जिनके लिए आप योग्य या लाइसेंसधारी नहीं हैं",
      "s5P3": "जहाँ ये शर्तें टूटती हैं वहाँ हम लिस्टिंग हटा सकते हैं और खाते निलंबित कर सकते हैं। उल्लंघन के लिए खाता निलंबित होने पर भुगतान योजना शुल्क आम तौर पर वापस नहीं होते।",
      "s6Title": "6. सशुल्क योजनाएँ और बूस्ट",
      "s6P1": "विक्रेता सदस्यता (Premium और Pro) और कारीगर बूस्ट एक निर्दिष्ट अवधि के लिए <1>एकमुश्त भुगतान</1> हैं। ये अपने आप नवीनीकृत नहीं होते, और भविष्य के शुल्कों के लिए कोई कार्ड संग्रहीत नहीं होता।",
      "s6P2": "फ़ीचर्ड प्लेसमेंट सुधारता है कि आप खोज में कहाँ दिखते हैं। यह बिक्री, पूछताछ, या किसी विशेष स्तर की रुचि की गारंटी नहीं देता।",
      "s6P3": "कीमतें बदल सकती हैं; कोई भी बदलाव नई खरीद पर लागू होता है, उस अवधि पर नहीं जिसका आप पहले ही भुगतान कर चुके हैं।",
      "s7Title": "7. यात्रा बुकिंग",
      "s7Body": "उड़ानें, होटल, कार किराया और हवाई अड्डा स्थानांतरण <1>तृतीय-पक्ष साझेदारों</1> के साथ, उनकी साइटों पर और उनकी शर्तों के तहत बुक होते हैं। उन बुकिंग के लिए आपका अनुबंध उनके साथ है, OAM के साथ नहीं। हम आपके लिए बिना किसी अतिरिक्त लागत के रेफ़रल कमीशन कमाते हैं।",
      "s8Title": "8. जो हम वादा नहीं कर सकते",
      "s8P1": "हम OAM को उपलब्ध और सटीक रखने का काम करते हैं, पर हम बैंकों, कार्ड प्रोसेसरों और उपयोगिता प्रदाताओं पर निर्भर हैं जिनके सिस्टम कभी-कभी विफल होते हैं। हम निर्बाध सेवा का वादा नहीं करते।",
      "s8P2": "यहाँ कुछ भी धोखाधड़ी के लिए, या नाइजीरियाई कानून के तहत जिसे वैध रूप से सीमित नहीं किया जा सकता उसके लिए, हमारे दायित्व को सीमित नहीं करता।",
      "s9Title": "9. अपना खाता बंद करना",
      "s9P1": "आप किसी भी समय अपना खाता बंद कर सकते हैं; पहले अपना बैलेंस निकाल लें, क्योंकि धन जारी करने से पहले हमें पहचान जाँच पूरी करनी पड़ सकती है।",
      "s9P2": "जहाँ हमें उचित रूप से धोखाधड़ी, अवैध उपयोग, या इन शर्तों के गंभीर उल्लंघन का संदेह हो, वहाँ हम खाता निलंबित या बंद कर सकते हैं। ऐसा करने पर, किसी कानूनी बाध्यता के अधीन जो इसे रोकती हो, हम वह बैलेंस लौटाएँगे जो वैध रूप से आपका है।",
      "s10Title": "10. परिवर्तन, कानून और विवाद",
      "s10P1": "हम इन शर्तों को अद्यतन कर सकते हैं। महत्वपूर्ण परिवर्तन लागू होने से पहले ईमेल या ऐप में सूचित किए जाएँगे।",
      "s10P2": "ये शर्तें <1>संघीय गणराज्य नाइजीरिया</1> के कानूनों द्वारा शासित हैं। कृपया पहले हमसे संपर्क करें — अधिकांश समस्याएँ ईमेल से जल्दी सुलझ जाती हैं।",
      "s10P3": "हमारी <1>गोपनीयता नीति</1> भी देखें।"
    }
  },

      "keepTitle": "Ogologo oge anyị na-edebe ya",
      "keepP1": "A na-edebe akụkọ akaụntụ na azụmahịa ka akaụntụ gị mepere emepe, na ruo oge ụfọdụ mgbe nke ahụ gasịrị iji zụọ ọrụ idebe akụkọ ego.",
      "keepP2": "A na-edebe ozi n'etiti ndị ọrụ ka akaụntụ abụọ na-anọ na-emeghe.",
      "rightsTitle": "Ikike gị",
      "rightsIntro": "N'okpuru Iwu Nchekwa Data Naịjirịa 2023 ị nwere ike ịrịọ anyị ka anyị:",
      "rightsLi1": "gosi gị data nkeonwe anyị nwere gbasara gị",
      "rightsLi2": "mezie ihe ọ bụla na-ezighi ezi",
      "rightsLi3": "hichapụ data anyị na-enwekwaghị ihe iwu kwadoro idebe ya",
      "rightsLi4": "kwụsị iji data gị maka otu ebumnuche",
      "rightsLi5": "nye data gị n'ụdị enwere ike ibufe",
      "rightsEmail": "Zipu email na <1>oamapp26@gmail.com</1>. Anyị ga-aza n'ime otu ọnwa.",
      "rightsKeep": "Data ụfọdụ anyị ga-edebe ọ bụrụgodị mgbe ị rịọsịrị — azụmahịa ego emechara, dị ka ọmụmaatụ, ebe iwu chọrọ ndekọ. Anyị ga-agwa gị ma ọ bụrụ na nke ahụ dabara.",
      "securityTitle": "Nchekwa",
      "securityP1": "A na-echekwa okwuntughe na hash, ọ bụghị n'ụdị enwere ike ịgụ ọ bụla. Ịkwụ ụgwọ na-agafe na mkpọchi echekwara nke Paystack. Enweta data ndị ahịa n'ime OAM bụ naanị ndị chọrọ ya iji rụọ ọrụ ahụ.",
      "securityP2": "Ọ dịghị usoro nwere nchekwa zuru oke. Ọ bụrụ na mmebi metụtara data gị, anyị ga-agwa gị na onye nrregulator dị ka iwu chọrọ.",
      "changesTitle": "Mgbanwe",
      "changesBody": "Ọ bụrụ na anyị gbanwee iwu a nke ukwuu, anyị ga-agwa gị site na email ma ọ bụ na ngwa tupu ọ malite ịrụ ọrụ. Lelekwa <1>Usoro Ọrụ</1> anyị."
    },
    "terms": {
      "title": "Usoro Ọrụ",
      "intro": "Nkwekọrịta dị n'etiti gị na O.A.M Motors Limited mgbe ị na-eji OAM.",
      "updated": "23 Julaị 2026",
      "s1Title": "1. Ndị anyị bụ",
      "s1Body": "<1>O.A.M Motors Limited</1> na-arụ OAM, ụlọ ọrụ e debere na Naịjirịa (RC <2>8034525</2>), adreesị e debere <3>Block Shop 11, No 2, Akinwunmi Street, Ojo, Lagos, Nigeria</3>. N'usoro ndị a \"anyị\" na \"OAM\" pụtara ụlọ ọrụ ahụ; \"gị\" pụtara onye nwe akaụntụ.",
      "s2Title": "2. Akaụntụ gị",
      "s2P1": "Ị ga-adị <1>afọ 18 ma ọ bụ karịa</1> ma nye nkọwa ziri ezi. Otu onye, otu akaụntụ. Ọ bụ gị nwere ọrụ idebe paswọọdụ gị na koodu otu oge na nzuzo — anyị agaghị arịọ gị ha ma ọlị, na onye ọ bụla rịọrọ esighị na OAM.",
      "s2P2": "Gwa anyị ozugbo na <1>oamapp26@gmail.com</1> ọ bụrụ na i kwenyere na onye ọzọ nwere ohere ịbanye n'akaụntụ gị.",
      "s3Title": "3. Akpa ego gị",
      "s3P1": "Ego dị n'akpa ego gị bụ ego anyị na-edebere gị. Ọ bụghị nkwụnye ụlọ akụ, ọ naghị enweta ọmụrụnwa, ọ dịghịkwa n'okpuru mkpuchi nkwụnye.",
      "s3P2": "Ị nwere ike iwepụ ego gị gaa n'akaụntụ ụlọ akụ n'aha gị n'oge ọ bụla, n'okpuru nlele ndị dị n'okpuru. Ịkwụ ụgwọ kaadị na-ebu ụzọ tinye n'akpa ego gị, akpa ego wee kwụọ ụgwọ ihe ị zụrụ — ya mere ọ bụrụ na nnyefe daghara, ego ahụ ka bụ nke gị dị ka ego dị.",
      "s3P3": "<1>Mbufe n'etiti ndị na-eji OAM bụ nke ikpeazụ.</1> Lelee aha onye nnata, nke a na-egosi tupu ị kwenye, n'ihi na mbufe emechara enweghị ike ịtụgharị.",
      "s4Title": "4. Ụgwọ, airtime na eletrik",
      "s4P1": "Anyị na-azụta ndị a n'aka ndị na-enye nke atọ nwere ikike site n'ntụziaka gị. Ọnụ ahịa e gosiri gị bụ ọnụ ahịa ị na-akwụ; uru anyị dị n'ime ya, a naghịkwa agbakwụnye ụgwọ dịiche.",
      "s4P2": "<1>Lelee onye nnata tupu ị kwenye.</1> Airtime e zigara na nọmba e depụrụ na-ezighi ezi, ma ọ bụ nkeji e zigara na mita na-ezighi ezi, anaghị enwetaghachikarị — e nyefeela uru ahụ na nọmba ma ọ bụ mita ahụ.",
      "s4P3": "Ebe azụmahịa dara n'aka onye na-enye, a na-eweghachi ego ahụ na akpa ego gị. Ebe onye na-enye na-egbu oge, iwu na-anọ na-emeghe ruo mgbe ọ kwụsịrị; ịzụ ọzọ n'oge igbu oge pụtara ịkwụ ụgwọ ugboro abụọ, anyị enweghịkwa ike iweghachi azụmahịa okpukpu abụọ ị họọrọ ime.",
      "s5Title": "5. Ahịa na Ọrụ Ụlọ",
      "s5P1": "<1>OAM abụghị akụkụ na azụmahịa ndị a.</1> Anyị na-enye ndepụta na ozi; nkwekọrịta dị n'etiti onye na-azụ na onye na-ere, ma ọ bụ onye ahịa na onye ọrụ aka. Anyị anaghị enyocha ngwaahịa, anaghị enyocha ọrụ, anaghị ejide ịkwụ ụgwọ na eskrow, anaghịkwa ekwe nkwa àgwà.",
      "s5P2": "Ọ bụ gị nwere ọrụ maka ihe ị depụtara, na maka imezu akụkụ gị nke ihe ọ bụla ị kwetara. A na-agbanwe nkọwa kọntaktị naanị mgbe onye na-ere ma ọ bụ onye ọrụ aka nabatara ajụjụ.",
      "s5ListIntro": "Ị gaghị edepụta, n'etiti ihe ndị ọzọ:",
      "s5Li1": "ihe ọ bụla iwu machibidoro ire na Naịjirịa",
      "s5Li2": "ngwa agha, ọgwụ ndị e ji nche, ma ọ bụ ngwaahịa ụgha",
      "s5Li3": "akụ ezuru ezu, ma ọ bụ ihe ọ bụla ị na-enweghị ikike ire",
      "s5Li4": "ọrụ ị na-erughị eru ma ọ bụ na-enweghị ikike inye",
      "s5P3": "Anyị nwere ike iwepụ ndepụta ma kwụsịtụ akaụntụ ebe e mebiri usoro ndị a. Ụgwọ atụmatụ akwụ ụgwọ anaghị enyeghachi ozugbo ebe a kwụsịtụrụ akaụntụ maka mmebi.",
      "s6Title": "6. Atụmatụ akwụ ụgwọ na nkwalite",
      "s6P1": "Ndenye aha onye na-ere (Premium na Pro) na nkwalite onye ọrụ aka bụ <1>ịkwụ ụgwọ otu ugboro</1> maka oge e kwuru. Ha anaghị emeghari onwe ha, a naghịkwa echekwa kaadị maka ịkwụ ụgwọ n'ọdịnihu.",
      "s6P2": "Ọnọdụ pụrụ iche na-eme ka ebe ị na-apụta na nchọ dịkwuo mma. Ọ naghị ekwe nkwa ire ahịa, ajụjụ, ma ọ bụ ọkwa ọmụmụ ọ bụla.",
      "s6P3": "Ọnụ ahịa nwere ike ịgbanwe; mgbanwe ọ bụla na-emetụta azụmahịa ọhụrụ, ọ bụghị oge ị kwụọlarị ụgwọ.",
      "s7Title": "7. Ndebe njem",
      "s7Body": "A na-edebe ụgbọ elu, hotel, mgbazinye ụgbọ ala na mbuli ọdụ ụgbọ elu na <1>ndị mmekọ nke atọ</1>, na saịtị ha na n'okpuru usoro ha. Nkwekọrịta gị maka ndebe ndị ahụ dị na ha, ọ bụghị OAM. Anyị na-enweta ọrụ nnyefe na-enweghị ụgwọ ọzọ n'ahụ gị.",
      "s8Title": "8. Ihe anyị enweghị ike ikwe nkwa",
      "s8P1": "Anyị na-arụsi ọrụ ike idebe OAM ka ọ dị ma dịkwa mma, mana anyị dabere na ụlọ akụ, ndị na-ahazi kaadị na ndị na-enye ọrụ ọha nke sistem ha na-adaghachi mgbe ụfọdụ. Anyị anaghị ekwe nkwa ọrụ na-akwụsịghị akwụsị.",
      "s8P2": "Ọ dịghị ihe ebe a na-ejide njedebe anyị maka aghụghọ, ma ọ bụ maka ihe ọ bụla enweghị ike ijide n'usoro iwu n'okpuru iwu Naịjirịa.",
      "s9Title": "9. Imechi akaụntụ gị",
      "s9P1": "Ị nwere ike imechi akaụntụ gị n'oge ọ bụla; buru ụzọ wepụ ego gị, n'ihi na anyị nwere ike ịchọ imecha nlele njirimara tupu ịhapụ ego.",
      "s9P2": "Anyị nwere ike ịkwụsịtụ ma ọ bụ mechie akaụntụ ebe anyị nwere obi abụọ ziri ezi maka aghụghọ, iji ihe na-ezighi ezi, ma ọ bụ mmebi dị njọ nke usoro ndị a. Ebe anyị mere, anyị ga-eweghachi ego ọ bụla bụ nke gị n'ụzọ ziri ezi, n'okpuru ọrụ iwu ọ bụla na-egbochi ya.",
      "s10Title": "10. Mgbanwe, iwu na esemokwu",
      "s10P1": "Anyị nwere ike imelite usoro ndị a. A ga-akọ mgbanwe dị mkpa site na email ma ọ bụ na ngwa tupu ha malite ịrụ ọrụ.",
      "s10P2": "Iwu <1>Nkeji Ala Ọha Naịjirịa</1> na-achị usoro ndị a. Biko buru ụzọ kpọtụrụ anyị — a na-edozi ọtụtụ nsogbu ngwa ngwa site na email.",
      "s10P3": "Lelekwa <1>Iwu Nzuzo</1> anyị."
    }
  },

    "terms": {
      "title": "Termini di servizio",
      "intro": "L'accordo tra te e O.A.M Motors Limited quando usi OAM.",
      "updated": "23 luglio 2026",
      "s1Title": "1. Chi siamo",
      "s1Body": "OAM è gestito da <1>O.A.M Motors Limited</1>, una società registrata in Nigeria (RC <2>8034525</2>), sede legale <3>Block Shop 11, No 2, Akinwunmi Street, Ojo, Lagos, Nigeria</3>. In questi termini «noi» e «OAM» indicano tale società; «tu» indica il titolare dell'account.",
      "s2Title": "2. Il tuo account",
      "s2P1": "Devi avere <1>18 anni o più</1> e fornire dati accurati. Una persona, un account. Sei responsabile di mantenere privati la password e i codici monouso — non te li chiederemo mai, e chi lo fa non è di OAM.",
      "s2P2": "Avvisaci subito a <1>oamapp26@gmail.com</1> se ritieni che qualcun altro abbia accesso al tuo account.",
      "s3Title": "3. Il tuo portafoglio",
      "s3P1": "Il saldo del tuo portafoglio è denaro che deteniamo per te. Non è un deposito bancario, non matura interessi e non è coperto da assicurazione sui depositi.",
      "s3P2": "Puoi prelevare il saldo su un conto bancario a tuo nome in qualsiasi momento, previe le verifiche seguenti. I pagamenti con carta accreditano prima il portafoglio, che poi paga il tuo acquisto — quindi se una consegna fallisce, il denaro resta tuo come saldo.",
      "s3P3": "<1>I trasferimenti tra utenti OAM sono definitivi.</1> Controlla il nome del destinatario, mostrato prima della conferma, perché un trasferimento completato non può essere annullato.",
      "s4Title": "4. Bollette, ricarica ed elettricità",
      "s4P1": "Le acquistiamo da fornitori terzi autorizzati su tua istruzione. Il prezzo mostrato è quello che paghi; il nostro margine è incluso e non viene aggiunta alcuna commissione separata.",
      "s4P2": "<1>Controlla il destinatario prima di confermare.</1> La ricarica inviata a un numero digitato male, o unità inviate al contatore sbagliato, in genere non possono essere recuperate — il valore è già stato consegnato a quel numero o contatore.",
      "s4P3": "Se un acquisto fallisce presso il fornitore, l'importo torna nel portafoglio. Se un fornitore è in ritardo, l'ordine resta aperto finché non si conclude; riacquistare durante un ritardo significa pagare due volte, e non possiamo rimborsare un acquisto duplicato che hai scelto di fare.",
      "s5Title": "5. Mercato e servizi a domicilio",
      "s5P1": "<1>OAM non è parte di questi accordi.</1> Forniamo l'annuncio e la messaggistica; l'accordo è tra acquirente e venditore, o cliente e artigiano. Non verifichiamo articoli, non ispezioniamo lavori, non tratteniamo pagamenti in deposito né garantiamo la qualità.",
      "s5P2": "Sei responsabile di ciò che pubblichi e di rispettare la tua parte di ogni accordo. I contatti si scambiano solo quando un venditore o artigiano accetta una richiesta.",
      "s5ListIntro": "Non puoi pubblicare, tra le altre cose:",
      "s5Li1": "qualsiasi cosa illegale da vendere in Nigeria",
      "s5Li2": "armi, droghe controllate o merci contraffatte",
      "s5Li3": "beni rubati, o qualsiasi cosa che non hai il diritto di vendere",
      "s5Li4": "servizi che non sei qualificato o autorizzato a fornire",
      "s5P3": "Possiamo rimuovere annunci e sospendere account in caso di violazione di questi termini. Le tariffe dei piani a pagamento in genere non sono rimborsabili quando un account è sospeso per violazione.",
      "s6Title": "6. Piani a pagamento e boost",
      "s6P1": "Gli abbonamenti venditore (Premium e Pro) e i boost artigiano sono <1>pagamenti una tantum</1> per un periodo indicato. Non si rinnovano automaticamente e nessuna carta è conservata per addebiti futuri.",
      "s6P2": "Il posizionamento in evidenza migliora dove appari nella ricerca. Non garantisce vendite, richieste né alcun livello particolare di interesse.",
      "s6P3": "I prezzi possono cambiare; ogni cambiamento si applica ai nuovi acquisti, non a un periodo già pagato.",
      "s7Title": "7. Prenotazioni di viaggio",
      "s7Body": "Voli, hotel, noleggio auto e transfer aeroportuali sono prenotati con <1>partner terzi</1>, sui loro siti e secondo i loro termini. Il tuo contratto per quelle prenotazioni è con loro, non con OAM. Percepiamo una commissione di segnalazione senza costi aggiuntivi per te.",
      "s8Title": "8. Cose che non possiamo promettere",
      "s8P1": "Lavoriamo per mantenere OAM disponibile e accurato, ma dipendiamo da banche, processori di carte e fornitori di servizi i cui sistemi a volte si guastano. Non promettiamo un servizio ininterrotto.",
      "s8P2": "Nulla qui limita la nostra responsabilità per frode, o per qualsiasi cosa che non possa essere legalmente limitata secondo la legge nigeriana.",
      "s9Title": "9. Chiusura del tuo account",
      "s9P1": "Puoi chiudere il tuo account in qualsiasi momento; preleva prima il saldo, poiché potremmo dover completare verifiche d'identità prima di rilasciare i fondi.",

      "moneyTitle": "Jak zarabiamy",
      "moneyP1": "Uważamy, że powinieneś to wiedzieć, bo usługa ukrywająca swój model przychodów zwykle ma ku temu powód.",
      "moneyP2": "Na rachunkach zarabiamy <1>niewielką marżę</1> — zwykle 10 do 20 ₦ przy zakupie za 1000 ₦ — wliczoną w widoczną cenę. Przy płatności nie ma osobnej opłaty, a pokazana kwota jest tą, którą płacisz.",
      "moneyP3": "Na Marketplace i w Usługach domowych zarabiamy na <1>opcjonalnych planach płatnych</1>: sprzedawcy mogą wykupić więcej ofert i wyróżnienie, a rzemieślnicy mogą podbić profil, by pojawiać się wyżej. Wystawianie i wiadomości są darmowe.",
      "moneyP4": "Na podróżach otrzymujemy <1>prowizję za polecenie</1> od partnerów rezerwacyjnych, bez dodatkowego kosztu dla Ciebie.",

      "safetyP1": "Numery telefonów na Marketplace i w Usługach domowych <1>nigdy nie są publikowane</1>. Wymieniane są dopiero, gdy sprzedawca lub rzemieślnik zaakceptuje Twoje zapytanie — dzięki temu żaden numer nie leży na publicznej stronie do zebrania, a dane kontaktowe dostajesz tylko od kogoś, kto naprawdę zgodził się z Tobą działać.",
      "safetyP2": "Płatności obsługuje <1>Paystack</1>. Dane karty wpisujesz na własnej bezpiecznej stronie Paystack i OAM nigdy ich nie widzi ani nie przechowuje.",
      "noteBody": "<1>Słowo o tym, gdzie jesteśmy.</1> OAM dopiero wystartowała, więc niektóre sekcje — zwłaszcza Marketplace i katalog rzemieślników — wciąż się zapełniają. Zasięg rośnie, gdy dołącza więcej osób, i wolimy to powiedzieć, niż udawać inaczej.",

          "a2": "Każdy token jest trwale przechowywany w <1>historii zamówień</1> — otwórz zamówienie i jest tam z przyciskiem kopiowania. Jest też w e-mailu z potwierdzeniem wysłanym wtedy.",
          "q3": "Numer licznika nie został przyjęty.",
          "a3": "Nigeryjskie liczniki przedpłacone mają <1>11 cyfr</1>. Sprawdzamy u twojego disco dopiero po wpisaniu wszystkich 11, więc komunikat podczas pisania znaczy tylko, że czekamy. Jeśli pełny numer wciąż jest odrzucany, sprawdź, czy wybrałeś właściwe disco — poprawny licznik na złym disco zawsze zawiedzie."
        },
        "wallet": {
          "title": "Portfel i płatności",
          "q1": "Dlaczego płatność kartą trafia najpierw do portfela?",
          "a1p1": "Płatności kartą zasilają portfel, a portfel płaci za zakup. Wygląda to jak dodatkowy krok i jest zamierzone.",
          "a1p2": "Jeśli dostawa się nie powiedzie, pieniądze są już bezpieczne w portfelu jako saldo do wydania lub wypłaty. Płacenie dostawcy bezpośrednio zostawiłoby pieniądze uwięzione między procesorem karty a nim, bez czystej drogi powrotu.",
          "q2": "Czy są ukryte opłaty?",
          "a2": "Nie. Suma pokazana przed zapłatą to tyle, ile płacisz — wiersz opłaty pokazuje ₦0, bo jej nie ma. Nasza marża jest wliczona w cenę rachunków, więc przy płatności nic nie dochodzi.",
          "q3": "Ile trwają wypłaty?",
          "a3": "Przelewy bankowe zwykle docierają w minuty, choć mogą trwać dłużej podczas awarii banku. Jeśli wypłata się nie powiedzie, kwota wraca automatycznie do portfela — nie ginie i możesz spróbować ponownie.",
          "q4": "Czy mogę wysłać pieniądze innemu użytkownikowi OAM?",
          "a4": "Tak — <1>Przelew</1> przenosi pieniądze między portfelami OAM natychmiast i za darmo. Wpisz e-mail lub numer, a nazwisko pojawi się przed potwierdzeniem. <2>Sprawdź to nazwisko uważnie</2>: zakończonych przelewów nie da się cofnąć."
        },
        "marketplace": {
          "title": "Rynek i rzemieślnicy",
          "q1": "Dlaczego nie widzę numeru sprzedającego?",
          "a1p1": "Numery nigdy nie są publikowane. Wyślij wiadomość o przedmiocie, a gdy sprzedający zaakceptuje, oboje zobaczycie swoje dane kontaktowe.",
          "a1p2": "Jest to nieco wolniejsze i to najskuteczniejsza ochrona, jaką możemy dać: opublikowane numery są zbierane, a zebrane używane do oszustw z podszywaniem.",
          "q2": "Ile rzeczy mogę wystawić za darmo?",
          "a2": "Trzy aktywne ogłoszenia, bezterminowo, bez karty. Premium (₦2,500) dodaje do 20 ogłoszeń plus wyróżnienie, a Pro (₦5,000) jest bez limitu.",
          "q3": "Jak zachować bezpieczeństwo przy kupnie i sprzedaży?",
          "a3li1": "Spotykajcie się w miejscu publicznym za dnia",
          "a3li2": "Obejrzyj przedmiot przed jakąkolwiek wymianą pieniędzy",
          "a3li3": "Nigdy nie wysyłaj pieniędzy z góry komuś, kogo nie spotkałeś",
          "a3li4": "Prowadź rozmowę w OAM, by był zapis ustaleń",
          "a3li5": "Każdą prośbę o przejście na WhatsApp „dla lepszej ceny” traktuj jako sygnał ostrzegawczy",
          "q4": "Co daje wyróżnienie profilu rzemieślnika?",
          "a4": "Umieszcza twój profil nad niewyróżnionymi w wynikach, gdzie patrzy większość. Premium to ₦2,500 na 30 dni, a Pro ₦5,000 na 90. Oba to <1>płatności jednorazowe</1> — nic nie odnawia się automatycznie."
        },
        "account": {
          "title": "Konto",
          "q1": "Czy mogę używać tego samego konta do kupna i sprzedaży?",
          "a1": "Tak. Jedno konto robi wszystko — możesz sprzedać lodówkę i wynająć hydraulika w tym samym tygodniu. Twoje wiadomości dzielą się na „Moje zapytania” i „Zapytania do mnie”, by się nie mieszały.",
          "q2": "Czy moja karta jest zapisana w OAM?",
          "a2": "Nie. Dane karty wpisuje się w bezpiecznym płatności Paystack i nigdy nie są przez nas widziane ani przechowywane."
        }
      }
    },
